auth_details: No authentication required for public package metadata endpoints
rate_limits: Currently no edge rate limiting for JSON, RSS, or Index APIs; respect caching/ETag guidance and identify requests with User-Agent.
description: Public JSON endpoints that expose package metadata, project details, and release information from the Python Package Index (pypi.org). Used by package managers, CI tooling, and developers to look up package versions, dependencies, and project metadata without scraping the web UI.
resolution_notes: rate_limits: auditor right — official docs state no edge rate limiting for JSON/RSS/Index APIs; XML-RPC may be limited; irresponsible use may be blocked (https://docs.pypi.org/api/ and https://warehouse.pypa.io/api-reference/). example.response_snippet: auditor right that 2.32.3 can be stale; use non-volatile snippet or live version — verify latest at https://pypi.org/pypi/requests/json.
